summary: Join our Agricultural Technology and Innovation course. Learn to implement effective solutions that promote sustainable agriculture and community growth.
lede: Agricultural technology and innovation training helps NGO professionals assess whether farming solutions fit program goals and deliver value. It is designed for staff who evaluate, approve or implement these solutions, and covers comparing costs and benefits, weighing sustainability trade-offs, and assessing community readiness and adoption barriers. Learners also explore digital tools for farmer support and develop donor-ready business cases and monitoring approaches to track adoption, yield, income, and sustainability outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for NGO professionals and partners who routinely evaluate, approve, or implement agricultural technology solutions, including: Program managers in agriculture, food security, and livelihoods. Field officers introducing new farming technologies in rural areas. Policy and advocacy officers shaping agricultural strategies. Donor and grant officers reviewing funding proposals. Agribusiness support teams in NGO settings. Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E) professionals tracking technology outcomes. Rural development coordinators applying climate-smart agriculture. Partnerships and innovation managers. Technology advisors working with farmers and communities. Anyone responsible for scaling agricultural impact through technology and innovation.
modules: The Case for Agricultural Innovation in NGOs
Digital Tools for Farmer Engagement and Support
Scaling Agricultural Innovations in Resource-Limited Settings
